description: Find public-source employment-law attorney listings near a US location. Returns source-attributed identity, firm, location, and contact data sorted by proximity. Person-specific filters and fields apply only where the underlying directory supports them; Google Places metrics are labeled as firm/office listing data, never individual ratings. Listings are not state-bar verification or an endorsement.

city.description: Optional city to tighten the search center (e.g. "Tampa").

contingency_fee.description: Filter on attorney-supplied fee data. Most listings are public office records that do not publish it; when none in range do, the tool returns total 0 with unsupported_filters rather than implying no attorneys are nearby.

free_consultation.description: Filter on attorney-supplied fee data. Most listings are public office records that do not publish it; when none in range do, the tool returns total 0 with unsupported_filters rather than implying no attorneys are nearby.

language.description: Filter on attorney-supplied language data. Most listings are public office records that do not publish it; when none in range do, the tool returns total 0 with unsupported_filters rather than silently implying no attorneys are nearby.

lat.description: Optional precise latitude. Overrides city/state when paired with lng.

lng.description: Optional precise longitude. Overrides city/state when paired with lat.

min_rating.description: Minimum individual-profile rating. Office/business ratings are never treated as an attorney rating, so this matches only hand-managed profiles and returns nothing where none exist.

radius_miles.description: Search radius. Defaults to 100mi for broad statewide coverage.

state.description: US state — 2-letter code or full name (e.g. "FL" or "Florida"). Required unless lat/lng given.

name: find_employment_attorney
title: Find an employment attorney
